title: GitLab CVE-2026-85706 is a maximum-severity path traversal in the repository commits API enabling unauthenticated arbitrary file read on sel
content_md:
GitLab CVE-2026-85706 is a maximum-severity path traversal in the repository commits API enabling unauthenticated arbitrary file read on sel

via Mastodon https://cyberworldops.eu/en/gitlab-path-traversal-flaw-enters-cisa-kev-with-three-day-patch

CVE-2026-85706.evidence: Event reports this maximum-severity path traversal was exploited one day after disclosure, enabling unauthenticated arbitrary file read on self-managed instances.
